User Story: As an admin, I can authenticate with a demo token
Acceptance Criteria: Token grants correct role and invalid token is rejected

User Story: As an admin, I can register AI agents
Acceptance Criteria: Agent appears in registry and persists

User Story: As an admin, I can register protected resources
Acceptance Criteria: Resource appears in registry and can be referenced by policies

User Story: As a reviewer, I can run tests in CI
As an admin, I can create allow/deny/approval policies
As a developer, I can simulate an agent request
As an auditor, I can view decision events
As an approver, I can approve a sensitive request
Acceptance Criteria: Pending approval changes to approved and audit is written

User Story: As an approver, I can reject a sensitive request
Acceptance Criteria: Pending approval changes to rejected and audit is written

User Story: As a developer, I can request a plain-English decision explanation
Acceptance Criteria: Explanation reflects deterministic decision and includes safety note

User Story: As a reviewer, I can inspect design and testing decisions
As a reviewer, I can access the deployed app
Acceptance Criteria: Production link loads and demo workflow works

User Story: As a reviewer, I can watch a complete demo
Acceptance Criteria: Recording is 15-20 minutes and shows all major workflows
